dialogues.speaker: Mandora
dialogues.text: Oh, I misspoke earlier. I should have said, "I stopped adventuring in Mandora's stead."

dialogues.speaker: Mandora
dialogues.text: She left me here, and returned to her world of thrilling travels and brilliant adventures. Tsk, she really is a clever girl! But you know, that's just typical of adventurers.

dialogues.speaker: Mandora
dialogues.text: Just like how anyone swearing "This is the last time, I promise!" always breaks their promises!

dialogues.speaker: Mandora
dialogues.text: *sigh* Of course, after becoming "Mandora," I can understand how she felt... So it's not like I'll get riled up over it. It's just that...

dialogues.speaker: Mandora
dialogues.text: After she left the Mirage... does she ever still think of me? If the thought of me could strengthen her resolve and help her walk her chosen path, that would really be something, haha.
